screen.mobhighlight.title: Mob Highlight - Settings
hint.mobhighlight.general: Master switch, detection radius and performance limits.
hint.mobhighlight.factions: Tags and spawn categories, grouped automatically. Every rule has its own outline color - click the color chip to cycle through presets.
hint.mobhighlight.custom: Create a rule with "New rule", then click its name to pick entities.
hint.mobhighlight.mobs: Click an entry to cycle: follow rule -> always glow -> never glow (the * prefix means it was picked by a custom rule). Built live from the entity registry, modded mobs included.
hint.mobhighlight.namespaces: Enable or disable whole namespaces (i.e. the mod a mob comes from).
gui.mobhighlight.no_rule: No custom rules yet - create one with the button above.
gui.mobhighlight.no_entities: Nothing picked yet - use "Add entities" below to choose some.
gui.mobhighlight.custom_hint: Custom rules outrank the default rules: picked entities use this rule's color and toggle instead of the one set on the Default rules tab. Remove an entity, or delete the rule, and it falls back to the default rule again. An entity can only belong to one custom rule.
gui.mobhighlight.custom_hint_short: Overrides the default rules; removing or deleting restores them
gui.mobhighlight.delete_rule.tooltip: Deletes the rule and everything picked; those entities fall back to the default rules.
gui.mobhighlight.remove_entity.tooltip: Click to remove it from this rule
gui.mobhighlight.add_entity.tooltip: Click to add it to this rule
gui.mobhighlight.entity_locked.tooltip: Already taken by rule "%s" - remove it there first
gui.mobhighlight.edit_rule.tooltip: Click to rename, recolor or pick entities
gui.mobhighlight.pick_group: Pick a default rule group first:
gui.mobhighlight.pick_entity: Group: %s - click an entry to add it to this rule
gui.mobhighlight.group.tooltip: This group holds %s entities - click to pick from them
message.mobhighlight.status:
[Mob Highlight] %1$s | radius %2$s | max %3$s | reclassify %4$s ms
Default rules: %5$s
Per-entity rules: %6$s
option.mobhighlight.see_through.tooltip: On: outlines show through blocks (vanilla glowing behaviour, zero extra cost). Off: only entities in your line of sight are outlined, with a small ray-casting cost per frame.
option.mobhighlight.hotkeys.tooltip: Opens the vanilla Controls screen, where H (toggle glow) and J (open settings) can be rebound.
